chars.RAPPER: a Moroccan young man about 20, curly dark hair in a short high-top, thin moustache, wearing an oversized mustard-yellow hoodie, black joggers, white sneakers, silver over-ear headphones around his neck
chars.DAD: a Moroccan man in his fifties, short grey hair, grey moustache, wearing a dark brown wool djellaba over a white shirt, reading glasses pushed up on his head
chars.MOM: a Moroccan woman in her late forties, plum-colored headscarf, wearing a soft beige house kaftan with small embroidery

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the bedroom doorway in a modest Casablanca apartment, head-to-waist framing: RAPPER sits on his bed staring at his phone with a huge surprised grin, one fist raised in quiet victory, face clearly visible; DAD stands behind him in the doorway, arms crossed, curious frown. Phone screen glows, no readable text. Evening light.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan family living room with a low round table and tea glasses: RAPPER proudly holds his phone out toward DAD, who leans in with raised eyebrows, half impressed; MOM beside them smiles with a hand on her chest. Warm lamp light, colorful sedari cushions.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: RAPPER alone at a small desk in his cramped bedroom at night, headphones on, writing lyrics in a notebook with intense determination, a cheap microphone on a stand next to him, desk lamp glow.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: RAPPER performing on a small neighborhood stage in Casablanca, gripping a microphone, eyes closed, passionate, a few young people in front cheering with raised phones (seen from behind, blurred). Night, colored stage lights.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: RAPPER sits on the edge of a Casablanca rooftop at dusk, seen from behind three-quarters, looking at the city skyline and the Hassan II mosque minaret far away, dreamy hopeful expression on his profile, satellite dishes and laundry lines around.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: A funny makeshift recording studio on a Casablanca rooftop: RAPPER records into a microphone hanging from a laundry line, surrounded by pots of cucumber and tomato plants and a foam mattress against the wall as soundproofing; he raps with big energy, face visible. Daylight, comic mood.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: RAPPER performing in an almost empty Moroccan café, only two old men drinking mint tea and ignoring him, one reading a newspaper; RAPPER keeps rapping into the mic with an awkward but brave smile. Afternoon, plastic chairs, comic mood.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: RAPPER at his desk buried under a pile of school textbooks and exam papers, holding his head in both hands, stressed, headphones around his neck, a microphone pushed to the side. Night, desk lamp.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: RAPPER stands tall on the Casablanca rooftop at sunrise, holding his microphone up toward the sky, confident smile, wind in his hoodie, the city glowing behind him. Hopeful, triumphant mood.
